AGREEMENT OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP OF THORNE 
HOLDINGS, L.P.
A Family Limited Partnership for Multi-Generational Asset Management & Valuation 
Discount Planning
THIS AGREEMENT OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP is made and entered into effective as of the 
15th day of November, 2026, by and among Thorne Management, LLC, a Texas limited liability 
company, as the General Partner, and VICTORIA H. THORNE, ALISTAIR C. THORNE, and the 
family trusts listed on Schedule A attached hereto, as the Limited Partners.
Article I: FORMATION, NON-TAX BUSINESS PURPOSE & PRINCIPAL 
OFFICE
Section 1.01 Formation Under State Act. The Partners hereby form a limited partnership 
pursuant to the Texas Business Organizations Code upon the filing of a Certificate of Formation 
with the Secretary of State of Texas.
Section 1.02 Legitimate Non-Tax Business Purposes. The Partnership is established for 
substantial, bona fide non-tax business and investment purposes, including: consolidating 
commercial real estate and private equity holdings; establishing centralized multi-generational 
investment governance; and protecting enterprise assets from judgment creditors.
Article II: CAPITAL CONTRIBUTIONS & UNIT STRUCTURE
Section 2.01 Initial Capital Contributions & Unit Classes. Each Partner has contributed 
property in exchange for Units:
• Class A GP Voting Units (1.00%): Held by Thorne Management, LLC (100% management 
control).
• Class B LP Non-Voting Units (99.00%): Held by Limited Partners, carrying zero voting rights.
Article III: MANAGEMENT & PRO-RATA DISTRIBUTIONS
Section 3.01 Management & Distributions. The General Partner shall have sole authority to 
manage operations and investments. All distributions shall be made strictly PRO RATA among 
all Partners in accordance with their respective Percentage Interests.
Article IV: TRANSFER RESTRICTIONS & RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL
Section 4.01 Transfer Restrictions & ROFR. No Limited Partner may transfer LP Units without 
GP consent. The Partnership retains a 90-day Right of First Refusal at appraised Fair Market 
Value with applicable minority and lack-of-marketability discounts.

THE THORNE IRREVOCABLE LIFE INSURANCE TRUST (ILIT)
Second-to-Die / Survivorship Estate Liquidity Trust with Crummey Mechanics
THIS IRREVOCABLE LIFE INSURANCE TRUST AGREEMENT is made this 15th day of 
November, 2026, by and between VICTORIA H. THORNE and ALISTAIR C. THORNE, of 
Houston, Texas (the "Grantors"), and SAMUEL T. STERLING (the "Independent Trustee").
Article I: IRREVOCABILITY & RELINQUISHMENT OF INCIDENTS OF 
OWNERSHIP
Section 1.01 Irrevocability & IRC § 2042 Safe Harbor. This Trust is strictly IRREVOCABLE. 
The Grantors permanently relinquish all incidents of ownership under IRC § 2042 in any life 
insurance policy held by the Trust.
Article II: ACQUISITION OF SURVIRORSHIP LIFE INSURANCE POLICY
Section 2.01 Survivorship Policy Acquisition. The Trustee is authorized to apply directly as 
owner and beneficiary for a $10,000,000 survivorship life insurance policy on the lives of the 
Grantors to avoid the IRC § 2035 3-year rule.
Article III: CRUMMEY DEMAND WITHDRAWAL RIGHTS
Section 3.01 Crummey Withdrawal Rights & Hanging Powers. Living children and 
grandchildren (Crummey Beneficiaries) have an immediate 30-day right to withdraw annual 
contributions up to statutory gift exclusion limits. Lapses are governed by the 5-and-5 Hanging 
Power rules under IRC § 2514(e).
Article IV: ESTATE TAX LIQUIDITY LOANS & ASSET PURCHASES
Section 4.01 Estate Liquidity Provisions. To preserve family real estate and business assets 
from forced liquidation upon death, the Trustee is authorized to purchase illiquid assets from or 
make secured loans to the Grantors' probate estates or Revocable Living Trust.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Grantors and Independent Trustee have executed this 
Agreement on November 15, 2026.
__________________________________________________
VICTORIA H. THORNE, Grantor
__________________________________________________
ALISTAIR C. THORNE, Grantor
__________________________________________________
SAMUEL T. STERLING, Independent Trustee

THE THORNE SPOUSAL LIFETIME ACCESS & DYNASTY 
TRUST
A GST-Exempt Multi-Generational Irrevocable Grantor Trust (South Dakota Domicile)
THIS IRREVOCABLE SPOUSAL LIFETIME ACCESS AND DYNASTY TRUST AGREEMENT is 
made this 15th day of November, 2026, by and between VICTORIA H. THORNE, of Houston, 
Texas (the "Grantor"), SAMUEL T. STERLING as Distribution Trustee, and South Dakota Trust 
Company LLC as Administrative Trustee.
Article I: IRREVOCABILITY & RECIPROCAL TRUST DOCTRINE 
COMPLIANCE
Section 1.01 Irrevocable Gift & Non-Reciprocal Drafting. Funded exclusively with Grantor's 
separate Class B LP Units in Thorne Holdings, L.P. Structured with distinct administrative terms 
under United States v. Estate of Grace to comply with the Reciprocal Trust Doctrine.
Article II: LIFETIME SPOUSAL ACCESS PERIOD (SLAT PHASE)
Section 2.01 Spousal Access & Divorce Cutoff. During the lifetime of Beneficiary Spouse 
ALISTAIR C. THORNE, the Independent Distribution Trustee may distribute income/principal for 
HEMS or in sole discretion. Spousal status terminates automatically upon divorce filing.
Article III: PERPETUAL MULTI-GENERATIONAL DYNASTY TRUST
Section 3.01 South Dakota Dynasty Situs. Upon the death of the Beneficiary Spouse, assets 
divide into perpetual GST-exempt Dynasty Sub-Trusts for descendants, governed under South 
Dakota law abolishing the Rule Against Perpetuities.
Article IV: INTENTIONALLY DEFECTIVE GRANTOR TRUST (IDGT) POWERS
Section 4.01 IDGT Substitution Power. Grantor retains nonfiduciary substitution powers under 
IRC § 675(4)(C), causing IDGT tax status to allow income tax payments and tax-free asset 
transfers.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Grantor and Trustees have executed this Agreement on 
November 15, 2026.
__________________________________________________
VICTORIA H. THORNE, Grantor
__________________________________________________
SAMUEL T. STERLING, Distribution Trustee

__________________________________________________
BEATRICE MONROE, Authorized Officer, South Dakota Trust Company LLC

THE VICTORIA H. THORNE 2026 ZEROED-OUT GRAT
Qualified Annuity Interest Estate-Freeze Trust Under IRC § 2702 & Treas. Reg. § 
25.2702-3
THIS GRANTOR RETAINED ANNUITY TRUST AGREEMENT is made this 15th day of 
November, 2026, by and between VICTORIA H. THORNE (the "Grantor") and SAMUEL T. 
STERLING (the "Trustee").
Article I: IRREVOCABILITY & INITIAL CONTRIBUTION
Section 1.01 Irrevocability & Funding. Irrevocable 2-year GRAT funded with Class B LP Units 
of Thorne Holdings, L.P. Additional contributions are strictly prohibited.
Article II: ANNUITY TERM & ZEROED-OUT ANNUITY PAYOUT
Section 2.01 Walton Zeroed-Out Structure. Pays mandatory annual annuity payments 
calculated under Walton v. Commissioner to yield a near-zero taxable gift on Form 709 ($1.00 
gift value) using the IRC § 7520 hurdle rate.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Grantor and Trustee have executed this Agreement on November

SHAREHOLDERS' BUY-SELL & RECAPITALIZATION 
AGREEMENT
Cross-Purchase / Wait-and-See Hybrid Succession Plan for Thorne Enterprises, Inc.
THIS BUY-SELL AND RECAPITALIZATION AGREEMENT is entered into this 15th day of 
November, 2026, by and among Thorne Enterprises, Inc., a Texas corporation, and its 
Shareholders.
Article I: DUAL-CLASS EQUITY RECAPITALIZATION
Section 1.01 Class A / Class B Dual Structure. Equity is divided into Class A Voting Common 
Stock (5% vote, restricted to active operational children Julian Thorne and Clara Thorne) and 
Class B Non-Voting Common Stock (95% equity, held by non-active heirs and trusts).
Article II: WAIT-AND-SEE CROSS-PURCHASE (CONNELLY COMPLIANT)
Section 2.01 Connelly Safe Harbor Priority. Structured to comply with Supreme Court ruling 
Connelly v. United States. Cross-purchase life insurance policies are owned by active 
shareholders (or an LLC) to prevent corporate valuation inflation.
Article III: VALUATION FORMULA & INSTALLMENT NOTE
Section 3.01 Valuation & Installment Terms. Valuation established by independent ASA 
appraisal (IRC § 2703 compliant). Uninsured balance payable via 20% cash down payment and 
10-year AFR promissory note.

THE THORNE CHARITABLE REMAINDER TRUST 
AGREEMENT
Tax-Exempt Split-Interest Trust Under IRC § 664 (FLIP-CRUT Structure)
THIS CHARITABLE REMAINDER TRUST AGREEMENT is made this 15th day of November, 
2026, by and between VICTORIA H. THORNE and ALISTAIR C. THORNE (Donors), and 
SAMUEL T. STERLING (Trustee).
Article I: IRREVOCABILITY & FLIP-CRUT ELECTION
Section 1.01 FLIP-CRUT Structure. Irrevocable tax-exempt split-interest trust under IRC § 664 
modeled on IRS Rev. Proc. 2005-52. Operates as NIMCRUT initially for appreciated 
commercial property and FLIPS to a Standard 6.00% CRUT on January 1st post-sale.
Article II: UNITRUST PAYOUT & STATUTORY TESTS
Section 2.01 Payout & Actuarial Tests. Pays 6.00% annual unitrust stream for joint lifetimes. 
Meets the statutory 10% minimum charitable remainder requirement under IRC § 664(d)(2)(D).
Article III: CHARITABLE REMAINDERMAN
Section 3.01 Private Foundation Remainder. Upon death of the survivor, remaining principal 
passes 100% to The Thorne Family Private Foundation (IRC § 170(c) / § 2055(a) compliant).
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Donors and Trustee have executed this Agreement on November 
15, 2026.
__________________________________________________
VICTORIA H. THORNE, Donor
__________________________________________________
ALISTAIR C. THORNE, Donor
__________________________________________________
SAMUEL T. STERLING, Trustee
